Name: Dragonskin
Components: V, S, M (the scale of a dragon who shares the resistance you wish to gain)
Description: Your skin becomes coated in draconic scales of a type you choose. Until the spell ends, your AC cannot be less than 16, regardless of what armor you're wearing. Depending on the type of dragon scales you choose, you gain resistance to the corresponding damage type. Furthermore, if you are subjected to the breath weapon of a dragon matching the scale type you choose, you may use your reaction to automatically succeed on your saving throws against that breath weapon. Color Resistance Amethyst Force Black, Copper Acid Blue, Bronze Lightning Brass, Gold, Red Fire Skull, Topaz Necrotic Emerald Psychic Green Poison Crystal, Moonstone, Platinum Radiant Sapphire Thunder Silver, White Cold
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
